title.narrative: Investment Promotion Program
Programa de Promocion de Inversiones

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a incrementar la Inversin Extranjera Directa (IED) en Paraguay, con un enfoque sectorial que promueva la generacin de empleo. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) generar capacidades para la implementacin de una estrategia proactiva para la promocin de inversiones; y (ii) adoptar instrumentos de promocin de inversiones basados en las mejores prcticas internacionales.

The programs overall objective is to increase foreign direct investment in Paraguay, with a sector approach that promotes job creation. The specific objectives are to: (i) build capacity for implementing a proactive investment promotion strategy; and (ii) adopt investment promotion instruments based on international best practices.
